candidate.definition_en: To relate to or be connected with.
candidate.explanation_ar: يخص أو يتعلق بـ. بتستخدم لما تقول إن الموضوع ده يخص كذا.

senses.definition_en: To relate to or be connected with.
examples: The documents pertain to the sale of the house.
The evidence does not pertain to the case at hand.
The documents pertain to the sale of the house.
The evidence does not pertain to the case at hand.
candidate.mnemonic: شبه 'Contain' بس دي 'Pertain'.. الموضوع ده بـ 'Pertain' ليك يعني يخصك.
